messages:
Maria H.: Quick thought — the onboarding tooltip for the console tour feels too eager. It pops right after signup and covers the header CTA. Suggest we tweak copy + timing.
Jon W.: Agree, saw this too. Users tend to click Next fast. Maybe change wording and delay 8–10s? :thinking_face: 
Aisha R.: +1 to a short delay. For copy, what about: `Quick tour: highlights core flows` — shorter than the current 'Get started with a quick guided tour of the console.'
Lee Z.: I worry 'Quick tour' is a bit vague. Maybe `See console walkthrough` keeps clarity. Also propose primary button `Start tour` and secondary `Remind me later` (instead of 'Skip').
Maria H.: Draft strings: primary = `Start walkthrough`, secondary = `Remind me later`. Tooltip blurb: `A short walkthrough of the console: deployments, jobs, and observability.` Thoughts?
Jon W.: A11y note — make sure the tooltip is announced correctly: role="dialog" + `aria-describedby` on the button. I'll add an accessibility checklist.
Aisha R.: Small nit on tone: prefer 'Remind me later' over 'Remind me' or 'Not now'. Feels less dismissive.
ProductBot: Added suggestion to the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding-tooltip (added by @Jon W.)
Lee Z.: I'll push two mock variants to Figma: (1) concise copy + 10s delay, (2) slightly more descriptive copy + 3s delay. We can AB test during the next onboarding cohort.
Maria H.: Can we aim to finalize copy by EOD so PM can hand off to eng for Monday? :thumbsup: 
Jon W.: Yep, updating the Figma text now and will paste exact tokens in the doc.
Aisha R.: Also creating an a11y ticket for keyboard focus/escape behavior — want to avoid focus trap when the tooltip appears.
Maria H.: Thanks — unless anyone objects, we'll land: primary `Start walkthrough`, secondary `Remind me later`, blurb `A short walkthrough of the console: deployments, jobs, and observability.`, delay 8s on first show.
Jon W.: No objections from me.
Lee Z.: Looks good. I'll attach the mocks and a short note on expected animations.
